name: How much does it cost to add a primary suite to a house in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to add a primary suite to a house in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of adding a primary suite in Orange County can vary significantly based on several factors, including the size of the addition, complexity of the design, chosen materials, and finishes. Generally, prices can range from $75,000 to over $200,000. Factors like plumbing for a new bathroom, electrical work, foundation requirements, and architectural fees all contribute to the overall expense. Obtaining detailed bids from licensed contractors is essential for an accurate estimate tailored to your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a primary suite addition in Orange County typically range from $75,000 to over $200,000, depending on size, complexity, and materials.
